# Contributing

Thank you for taking the time to contribute. Translation fixes are welcome.

To contribute, follow these steps:

1. Open [New issue](https://github.com/nukeratframework/docs/issues/new/choose) and select **Docs translation**.
2. Fill in the required fields.
3. Fork the repository, create a **branch** from `main`, do not commit on your fork `main`, and open a PR into `main` on `nukeratframework/docs`.

## Requirements

- English (`en-us`) is the source. Edit the matching file under `src/pages/docs/mdx/<locale>/`
- Translate wording only. Leave code, commands, and identifiers unchanged
- Keep the same file path as the English page
